### 2026-10-07 – Read a bunch of datasheets and integrated the battery charging circuit and IC using the TI BQ25185DLHR to charge the batt, it also was power path, to power and charge at the same time, from usb. Next

**0.98h**

Read a bunch of datasheets and integrated the battery charging circuit and IC using the TI BQ25185DLHR to charge the batt, it also was power path, to power and charge at the same time, from usb. Next step is to switch the LDO to a much more efficient Buck-Boost converter to greatly improve battery life
